notes.title: Patch Notes 1.2.2.5
notes.content:
-A new skill has been added, to use it press the LB key on your controller or Q on the keyboard, you can change the assigned button in the settings.

-The new skill allows you to dodge while hitting, this skill consumes mana.

-Mana has been added to Ruy.

-The old experience bar now shows Ruy's mana.

-Power stones now require mana to use.

-Minor bug fixes.
